description: This file defines a mock class 'MainThreadFactoryMock' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IMainThreadFactory' interface and provides a mocked method 'getMainThread' to return a shared pointer to 'IMainThread'. It is used in the context of the Rialto server component for media handling, specifically within the mock namespace.
